scope: Prospective standard-library source/AST/diff review only. No closed-result gates were executed or result values/archives/arrays opened.

current_phase_gate_review.check: Exact3 COMPLETE receipt schemas/statuses/identities/OFF roles, exact753-map and54-context QA schemas/statuses/counts, primary/context/QA own code and scope SHA links, primary receipt dictionaries, context receipt and common science freeze are bound to SHA-authenticated bytes loaded and parsed together. Contracts match frozen prospective producer/QA source.
current_phase_gate_review.independent_QA_output_admission: Every primary output_byte_pin and every context output_pin must equal actual independent QA input-byte pins. Every packaged NPZ additionally must belong to this phase results/ and match those pins.

manifest_and_members.exact_member_identity: Canonical confined source/archive names, unique source and archive paths, reservedMANIFEST.json excluded from root members, integer byte counts and64hexSHA. Gate files/all declared primary/context outputs must be members; every actual regular results/ file must be listed.
manifest_and_members.figure_interface_repaired: Exact phase delivery/SETI_CONTROL_TARGETS_2026-10-11.png is admitted only when also declared in required_report_paths and the exact closed root byte manifest. Other PNGs must belong to phase results/. Numerical NPZ admission remains results/+actualQA only.

FD_integrity_review.writer: Exclusive create xb; original writer FD retained through ZipFile writer close, writerflush/fsync, both fresh reader validations, terminal receiptfsync and parentdirectoryfsync, then closed.
FD_integrity_review.fresh_reader: O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW plus regular fstat/lstat and exact(dev,inode,size) equality against original writer. That same reader is used for wholeZIP SHA then seek0/ZipFile exact member names/count/no duplicates and every member EOF CRC, size and SHA.
FD_integrity_review.terminal_recheck: After selected-source and gate byte reauthentication, independently reopen a fresh nofollow reader, repeat retained-writer identity and wholeZIP SHA. No central-directory-only rescue, replacement or overwrite.
FD_integrity_review.source_pre_stream_post: All selected source whole-file pins checked before streaming; each streamed size/SHA checked; all selected source/code/manifest/GO pins and metadata admission rechecked afterward.

resources_and_control.actual_GO: Exact SHA-bound GO_SERIALIZED_CLOSED_CONTROL_RESULTS_ARCHIVE requires matching builder/manifestSHA,caps and all_filesystem_actors_paused:true.
resources_and_control.locks: Retained exclusive nonblocking family lock and archive lock.
resources_and_control.guards: Unique inode allocated workspace accounting; reserve500MiB+8MiB; during-stream/final archive checks; measured CPU/wall/RSS checked and rounded terminalreceipt storage reserved before PASS.
resources_and_control.create_only_failure: Existing archive or receipt rejects. New partial archive and INCOMPLETE terminal evidence preserved on failure; no automatic retry/resume.

changes_reviewed: Original builder copied only BASE→v2 initially
Narrow fresh reader FD binding added after independent review
Exact producer-declared final report PNG path exception added to resolve known interface mismatch
limitations: This is prospective source review, not actual packaging/CRC/SHA/readback or durable-save proof. Root must admit all actual3 primary completions, both actual QA PASS receipts and context completion before serialized archive GO.
No original HDF5 source payload is duplicated; reproduction needs separately authenticated source package.
Manifest contains predeclared byte-pinned report/figure outputs; root owns scientific report review and final delivery claims.
